messages:
olivia_cust: Hey team — I redeemed promo code `REDWOOD-DED-100` during signup but it looks like the credit landed on our Hosted account instead of Dedicated. We need Dedicated capacity for onboarding (org: acme-inc). Can you either move the credit or reapply? :confused:

manny_cs: Sorry about that — can you DM me the org id, invoice number, and a screenshot of where it shows up? quick check: which SKU shows the credit? e.g. `hosted_standard` vs `dedicated_1xA100`?

olivia_cust: Sent the screenshot in DM and posting the invoice id here: `INV-2025-0442`. The UI shows `Applied to: hosted_standard` and promo `REDWOOD-DED-100`.

manny_cs: Thanks. Looping in billing — @sara_billing can you take this? looks like promo was SKU-restricted but applied to wrong product.

sara_billing: Thanks @manny_cs. I'll investigate. Quick note: many promos are SKU-bound which can cause automatic application to a matching Hosted SKU if Dedicated wasn't setup at time of redemption. Are you asking to have the 100 USD credit moved to Dedicated or to issue a refund so it can be reapplied?

olivia_cust: Prefer moved if possible — we want to start Dedicated right away. If you need explicit approval I can confirm here.

billing-bot: Ticket created: TCK-8421 — Billing investigation opened for INV-2025-0442 (sara_billing assigned).

sara_billing: Confirmed — we can do a ledger transfer to move the credit from Hosted to Dedicated, but it requires manual adjustment and a 24-48h processing window. Proceeding on confirmation from the customer.

jordan_support: For a faster workaround, I can provision a 7-day Dedicated trial seat to unblock load testing while billing does the ledger move. If you want that, tell me which instance size (`dedicated_1xA100` or `dedicated_2xH100`).

olivia_cust: Thanks — please provision `dedicated_1xA100` trial. Also please move the 100 USD credit when you can. Appreciate it!

sara_billing: Got it — provisioning the ledger move now, you'll get an email when complete. ETA 1 business day. Assigning action to finance: FIN-3037.

manny_cs: Great — tagging this resolved for the support queue. Reopen if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:
